violation_type.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))
violation_type.short_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised
violation_type.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would step out of the room to go to the kitchen and leave infants unsupervised.

finding_variants.text: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would step out of the room to go to the kitchen and leave infants unsupervised.
An infant was sleeping in a room with no caregiver present.
The infant room was absent of any caregiver when the children were observed napping.
A caregiver was observed stepping out of their classroom two times leaving infants unsupervised.

During the inspection I observed a 2 month old infant in a crib on the other side of a half wall alone. Three caregivers were observed on the other side of the wall with 10 infants. When inquired a caregiver stated the infant was asleep.     This was corrected when the infant was found to be awake and the caregiver went on the other side of the wall and removed the infant from the crib.
During the walkthrough I observed a classroom with 7 infants ages 6m, 7m, 8m 11m,12m,14m and 17 months left unsupervised.     This was corrected when the caregiver returned to the classroom.
